title: Fixed a bug where the `hiddenColumns` and `hiddenRows` indicators were drawn just outside the cell they belong to, which made the grid report content it could not fit. A grid using `stretchH` with frozen columns showed a horizontal scrollbar that had nothing to scroll, and its rows drifted apart across the frozen boundary once scrolled to the bottom; a grid using `height: 'auto'` grew a vertical scrollbar it should never have. Both indicators are now drawn inside their cell.
